verdicts.reason: Both scatter the content across the banner. The 'RSVP Free' CTA is shrunk to one pill in a row with the FREE ENTRY/ALL AGES/TASTINGS tags, so it is buried. The time/location line is stranded at the far right, away from the date. The secondary copy and URL are tiny left-column text. A also shows the broken red 'missing asset / partner' placeholder text crammed against the TASTINGS pill. B shrinks that placeholder to a small red stub, which is less visible, and keeps the 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' eyebrow grouped above the left column, so B is slightly less broken.
